6: Construct: totals and ratios. Total pages is administrative plus informational plus product related. Total duration is the sum of the three durations. Average time per page is total duration divided by total pages, where replace zero with not a number avoids division by zero, and fillna zero sets empty sessions to zero, with no if else needed. Product share is product related pages divided by total pages. The summary: total pages averages thirty four point six, total duration thirteen hundred ten seconds, average time per page thirty seven point eight seconds, and product share point nine zero five.

But note that rates, from zero to point two, have tiny variance only because of their scale, so apply this filter to zero one dummies, not raw rates. Then a correlation matrix of the absolute values finds the most redundant pairs: product related and total pages, point nine nine seven; product related duration and total duration, point nine nine four; bounce rates and bounce times exit, point nine seven nine; has page value and log page values, point nine two three; bounce rates and exit rates, point nine one two.
